g.text: SKILL 3 OF 5 · §2.3 PAPER2VIDEO
Paper2Video plans duration before rendering, anchors narration to visible
objects, and gates an editable deck plus two MP4s
Figure 5: assets → pace narration → deck via the full ppt-master workflow → anchored visual cues → render → fit gate
FIG. 5
ROOT DELIVERABLES AND THE PACKAGE GATE
video.pptx — the editable deck, produced by the full ppt-master route [22]; not a disposable
intermediate
video.mp4 with burned-in subtitles and video_no_subtitles.mp4 for the reel's own caption
toggle; same frames, audio, highlight timing
assets/ keeps narration audio, subtitle sidecars, frames, duration reports, cue plans,
timeline.json, QA reports
check_video_package.py is the release contract: files exist and play, audio stream present,
duration in tolerance, non-empty sidecar, cues timed inside their audio segment, no
word-sized highlight boxes, blank frames and text overflow caught, unsafe rate changes
rejected

g.text: ID
Requirement
Solution the paper gives
B1
Duration must be planned before rendering — cutting the MP4,
clipping audio, or a large speed-up is unsafe
The planner estimates the script before TTS and asks for semantic rewrites; a post-render duration report; small residuals repaired by a
bounded speech-rate plan, large ones return to rewriting
B2
The viewer needs attention guidance, not only slide playback
The deck workflow attaches semantic anchors to the objects the narration names; a cue resolver combines script, word timings, geometry,
and anchors into visual_cues.json; normalized geometry survives resolutions; default style spotlight_laser
B3
Captions have two delivery contexts — shareable MP4 vs the
interactive reel
Burned-in subtitles in video.mp4; a clean video_no_subtitles.mp4 so the reel's caption toggle never doubles subtitles
B4
The video has to remain addressable after export
timeline.json maps each section or narration chunk to its audio window, subtitle cues, slide frame, and accepted visual cue; Paper2Reel
reads it directly
B5
Media failures need deterministic checks
One mandatory package gate catches missing audio, empty or doubled subtitles, malformed highlight boxes, timeline drift, blank frames,
and unsafe duration fixes
Source: arXiv:2607.04438 v2 (19 Jul 2026)
